description_en: Disables a firewall policy for a specified simple application server
description_zh: 禁用指定轻量应用服务器的一条防火墙策略
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open disable-firewall-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id eeea34d9867b4d55a4ff8d5fcfbd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableFirewallRule

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the specified simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the specified simple application server. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client-generated parameter value that is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The firewall rule ID. You can call the ListFirewallRules operation to obtain the firewall rule ID
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙规则ID。您可以通过调用ListFirewallRules接口获取防火墙规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the firewall rule
parameters.name: remark
